member.name: M:NightscoutFoundation.Nocturne.Api.IOidcApiSync.OidcUnlinkIdentity(System.String)
member.summary: Unlink an OIDC identity from the currently-authenticated subject. Blocked if this would leave the subject with zero primary auth factors.
member.remarks: Factor-count enforcement is handled atomically inside TryRemoveOidcIdentityAsync using a serializable transaction to prevent TOCTOU races between concurrent removals. Returns FactorRemovalResult to distinguish between not-found, last-factor, and success.
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call
member.param: The unique identifier of the OIDC identity to unlink.

member.name: M:NightscoutFoundation.Nocturne.Api.OidcApi.OidcUnlinkIdentity(System.String)
member.summary: Unlink an OIDC identity from the currently-authenticated subject. Blocked if this would leave the subject with zero primary auth factors. Factor-count enforcement is handled atomically inside TryRemoveOidcIdentityAsync using a serializable transaction to prevent TOCTOU races between concurrent removals. Returns FactorRemovalResult to distinguish between not-found, last-factor, and success.

member.param: The unique identifier of the OIDC identity to unlink.

member.name: M:NightscoutFoundation.Nocturne.Api.IStatisticsApiSync.StatisticsGetMultiPeriodStatistics
member.summary: Gets comprehensive statistics for multiple time periods (1, 3, 7, 30, and 90 days). Fetches sensor glucose, bolus, carb, and temp-basal data from the database for each period, computes GlucoseAnalytics, TreatmentSummary, and InsulinDeliveryStatistics, and caches the result for 5 minutes.
member.remarks: When no TempBasal or algorithm bolus records are found but a profile is loaded, the method falls back to computing scheduled basal from the active profile schedule via IBasalRateResolver. GMI reliability is assessed per-period using context-appropriate recommended-day minimums (e.g., 1-day periods cannot require 14 days of data).

member.name: M:NightscoutFoundation.Nocturne.Api.IStatisticsApiAsync.StatisticsGetMultiPeriodStatisticsAsync(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Gets comprehensive statistics for multiple time periods (1, 3, 7, 30, and 90 days). Fetches sensor glucose, bolus, carb, and temp-basal data from the database for each period, computes GlucoseAnalytics, TreatmentSummary, and InsulinDeliveryStatistics, and caches the result for 5 minutes.
member.remarks: When no TempBasal or algorithm bolus records are found but a profile is loaded, the method falls back to computing scheduled basal from the active profile schedule via IBasalRateResolver. GMI reliability is assessed per-period using context-appropriate recommended-day minimums (e.g., 1-day periods cannot require 14 days of data).
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call
member.param: Cancellation Token to cancel the request.

Uses patient device records to segment the period by algorithm and compute time-weighted metrics via IAidMetricsService. member.name: M:NightscoutFoundation.Nocturne.Api.StatisticsApi.StatisticsGetMultiPeriodStatistics
member.summary: Gets comprehensive statistics for multiple time periods (1, 3, 7, 30, and 90 days). Fetches sensor glucose, bolus, carb, and temp-basal data from the database for each period, computes GlucoseAnalytics, TreatmentSummary, and InsulinDeliveryStatistics, and caches the result for 5 minutes. When no TempBasal or algorithm bolus records are found but a profile is loaded, the method falls back to computing scheduled basal from the active profile schedule via IBasalRateResolver. GMI reliability is assessed per-period using context-appropriate recommended-day minimums (e.g., 1-day periods cannot require 14 days of data).
member.exception: Thrown when fails to make API call

Whatever you set here will be prepended to the value defined in AddApiKey.
An example invocation here might be:
ApiKeyPrefix["Authorization"] = "Bearer";
… where ApiKey["Authorization"] would then be used to set the value of your bearer token.
OAuth2 workflows should set tokens via AccessToken.
